---
title: "Why doesn't my return depend only on the interest rate?"
description: ""
icon: "circle-help"
section: "portfolio"
sectionTitle: "Portfolio"
order: 14
---

Your return depends on the interest generated and the influence of currency exchange fluctuations between the time of investment and the time of return.

**Forex**: Gain or loss generated by the difference in exchange rates between the investment date and the return date.

**Currency exchange rate:** The value relationship between two currencies, defining how much one is worth relative to the other.

**Spreads:** The exchange rate difference at the exchange house between the reference price (in our case Coinmarketcap) and the price actually offered by the exchange house.
